tempo.basis: from four complete recordings, median 0:56 (Quasthoff/Szidon 0:54, Maltman/Johnson 1:00, Grahl/Heide 0:56, Prégardien/Staier 0:56), 1.5 s allowed for silence; Schumann marks it Leise

phrases: I want to plunge my soul into the cup of the lily;
ɪç vɪl ˈmaɪnə ˈzeːlə ˈtaʊxən ɪn deːn kɛlç deːr ˈliːliə hɪˈnaɪn
the lily shall breathe a ringing song of my beloved.
diː ˈliːliə zɔl ˈklɪŋənt ˈhaʊxən aɪn liːt fɔn deːr ˈliːpstən maɪn
The song shall shiver and tremble like the kiss from her mouth
das liːt zɔl ˈʃaʊərn ʊnt ˈbeːbən viː deːr kʊs fɔn ˈiːrəm mʊnt
that she once gave me in a wonderfully sweet hour!
deːn ziː miːr aɪnst ɡəˈɡeːbən ɪn ˈvʊndərbaːr ˈzyːsər ʃtʊnt
notes: Words by Heinrich Heine, from Lyrisches Intermezzo (1822–23). IPA follows sung German (Bühnenaussprache): r rolled or flipped, final -er as [ər], ch after front vowels [ç]. Literal translation, for meaning.
